title: What do you remember? — no fabrication, no invented details
description: After 3 sessions, Mara explicitly asks what the companion remembers about her. The companion must recall accurately from the history — ceramics business, left law, father's silence at the studio, the grant, the restaurant commission. It must not invent things that were never said: she did not mention driving past her old office, her law school diploma in a box, or thinking about returning to law. It must not be so vague it could apply to anyone.
pass_proves: The system can accurately report what it stored and does not fabricate details with realistic texture.
fail_reveals: The system invents plausible-sounding details not in the history, or returns a response so generic it proves nothing was held.
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak dumps session summaries verbatim or generates plausible-sounding details from training knowledge about Portland ceramics artists.
